title: Dry Density from Wet Density and Moisture Content
applicability: Fundamental relationship. γ_wet can come from NDG direct read, sand cone (W_soil/V_hole), or drive cylinder. w from oven-drying (ASTM D2216) or NDG moisture reading. Always verify NDG moisture against oven-dried samples periodically.

title: Relative Compaction (Percent Compaction)

γ_d_field.description: Field dry density from density test

γ_d_max.description: Maximum dry density from Proctor test (D698 or D1557)

applicability: Compare against specification requirement. Critical: the reference test (standard vs. modified Proctor) must match the specification. 95% of modified Proctor ≈ 100% of standard Proctor for many soils.

title: Sand Cone — Volume of Test Hole

W_sand_total.description: Total weight of sand used (initial - remaining in jar)

W_sand_cone.description: Weight of sand filling the cone and base plate (determined by calibration)

γ_sand.description: Calibrated bulk density of Ottawa sand

applicability: Sand density calibration: fill a container of known volume 3 times; average. Use same sand (graded Ottawa sand C778, 20-30 mesh). Sand must be dry. Recalibrate if sand is replaced or moisture changes.

W_soil.description: Total weight of soil excavated from test hole

V_hole.description: Volume of test hole (from sand replacement)

title: Zero Air Voids (ZAV) Curve

γ_d_ZAV.description: Dry density at zero air voids (100% saturation)

applicability: The ZAV line is the theoretical upper bound — no soil can be compacted above this line (would require negative air voids). The Proctor curve approaches but never reaches the ZAV line. Used as a quality check: any test point above ZAV is erroneous.

title: Degree of Saturation from Density Test Results
equation: S = w × G_s / e;  where e = (G_s × γ_w / γ_d) - 1
applicability: S > 1.0 is impossible — indicates error in measurement (density too high, moisture too high, or wrong G_s). At optimum moisture content from Proctor, S typically ≈ 75–85%.

title: Relative Density (Granular Soils)

e_max.description: Maximum void ratio (loosest state, ASTM D4254)

e_min.description: Minimum void ratio (densest state, ASTM D4253)

applicability: Used for clean granular soils (< 12% fines) where Proctor compaction curve is meaningless. Dr < 35%: loose. 35–65%: medium dense. 65–85%: dense. > 85%: very dense. Note: relative density tests have significant variability (±10–15%).

title: NDG Moisture Correction (Oven-Dry Verification)

w_NDG.description: Nuclear gauge moisture reading for the test

w_oven.description: Oven-dried moisture content of verification sample

w_NDG_check.description: NDG moisture reading on the verification sample

applicability: NDG moisture is approximate — affected by bound water, chemical composition, and organic content. Good practice: take oven-dry samples every 10th test (or per specification) and apply systematic offset correction if bias is found. Some specifications require all moisture by oven-drying.
